title: Determining if a Mobile Home is Exempt or Taxable
summary: Decision tree for whether a mobile home, recreational mobile home, or camping trailer is exempt or taxable: RMH definition, parking permit fee, dealer stock-in-trade, motor vehicle, camping trailer, and default real-property assessment.
disclaimer: This flow chart provides general information and may not apply in every situation. A thorough review of each property is still required.
router_description: Determining if a mobile home is exempt or taxable. Decision tree for recreational mobile homes, camping trailers, manufactured homes: exempt vs taxable under sec. 70.11, 70.111, 70.112, 70.17 and parking permit fees 66.0435.

nodes.question: Is the property a recreational mobile home (RMH) as defined in sec. 66.0435(1)(hm), Wis. Stats.?
Is the property subject to the monthly mobile home parking permit fee under secs. 70.112(7) and 66.0435(3), Wis. Stats.?

authorities.note: property subject to the parking permit fee is exempt from property tax
monthly mobile home parking permit fee

nodes.question: Is the property merchant's stock-in-trade (vacant mobile homes for sale by a dealer) under sec. 70.111(17), Wis. Stats.?
Is the property a motor vehicle (bus or van) under sec. 70.112(5), Wis. Stats.?
Is the property a camping trailer that meets all of the requirements under secs. 70.111(19)(a) and 340.01(6m), Wis. Stats.?
criteria: A vehicle with a collapsible or folding structure
Designed to provide temporary living quarters for recreation, camping or travel use

Designed to be towed upon a highway by a motor vehicle during the year prior to the assessment date (e.g. towed on the highway during 2024 establishes a trailer is designed to be towed upon a highway for the January 1, 2025 assessment)

nodes.question: Is the property a camping trailer that is no longer designed to (a) provide temporary living quarters (e.g. changes, additions, attachments, decks or patios that establish use as living quarters that is not temporary) OR (b) be towed upon a highway by a motor vehicle (e.g. changes or modifications to the trailer such that it is no longer designed to be towed upon a highway)?

authorities.note: referenced by the outcome for camping trailers no longer designed for temporary living or highway towing

nodes.label: Property is taxable
nodes.question: The property does not meet any of the above requirements.
nodes.action: The property does not meet any of the above requirements. The property is taxable under sec. 70.17(3), Wis. Stats., which requires real property assessment of mobile homes unless they are subject to a parking permit fee or qualify for exemption under state law.

authorities.note: real property assessment of mobile homes

nodes.label: Property is exempt
nodes.action: Property is exempt, including steps and a platform not exceeding 50 sq. ft. that lead to the doorway.

nodes.label: Property is exempt
nodes.action: Property is exempt (subject to the monthly mobile home parking permit fee).

nodes.label: Property is exempt
nodes.action: Property is exempt. Note: Exemption does not apply to land, additions, attachments, decks or patios.

nodes.label: Apply the Real vs. Personal Property process
nodes.action: Apply the "Determining Real or Personal Property" process starting on page 18-1 of the WPAM to determine if taxable real property or exempt personal property under sec. 70.111(28), Wis. Stats.
